messages:
Elaine: Thanks everyone for coming — follow-up thread for product roadmap Qs from today's all-hands (API / Console / Optimize). Post questions here and we'll answer live.
Tim_P: Quick update on API streaming/quality timeline: streaming perf improvements -> internal canaries in Aug, public beta late Aug, GA target end of Q3. This depends on the runtime kernel perf branch.
Mita: Are those kernel changes going to require API surface changes or just runtime upgrades? We need to know for the Dedicated customers.
Tim_P: Runtime-only for basic streaming. There will be an optional new param for partial-chunk streaming and improved resume semantics — fully backward compatible. Dedicated customers can opt-in to runtime image that enables the kernels.
Jordan: Console question: token-level cost breakdown per-route — when is that expected? Customers are asking for per-team billing visibility.
Carla: Console per-route dashboards are in alpha with 3 pilot customers. Plan: wider beta late Q3, GA Q4. The beta will include token-level breakdown, per-model cost estimation, and per-route anomaly alerts.
Mita: For Optimize (batching/quant suggestions) — timeline? Any early access program?
Tim_P: Optimize roadmap: intelligent batching suggestions (auto-suggest batch size + KV caching hints) -> EA in Sep, public beta Q4. Quantization and model-variant recommendations (quality vs cost) -> alpha in Q4, GA early next year (Q1 2025).
Elaine: To be clear: EA/beta windows above are 'invite-only' then open beta. We'll announce signups next week.
Jordan: SDKs — will we need a new major to support the Console/Optimize hooks? Some customers want a single CLI/SDK for console + hosted API features.
Tim_P: SDKs will be additive. SDK v3 will include helper functions for console route management and Optimize hooks but remain backwards compatible. v3-beta planned in ~2 weeks, GA aligned with console beta.
Mita: Any blockers we should know about for runtime kernel landing? Perf regression risk or hardware-specific issues?
Tim_P: The main risk is a regression on short-sequence latencies for a small subset of model shapes. Eng-runtime is running a broad regression suite; if regressions appear we'll gate the public beta until mitigations land. We're tracking on ENG-4552.
Elaine: Can we publish a short checklist for customers so they understand what to expect when we flip the runtime image (Dedicated/Private)?
Carla: Yep — will draft a one-pager (compatibility, rollback steps, expected perf delta) and attach to the console beta invite flow.
Jordan: For rollouts: will we support canary A/B on Console for model variant routing (i.e., route 10% to quantized model)?
Tim_P: Yes. Rollouts will support percentage traffic split and automatic fallback to a compatible variant on errors. That capability will be in console beta.
Mita: @Tim_P can you drop the RFC link for the runtime changes here? I want to triage test coverage.
Tim_P: Sure — filing the RFC now and will paste the link once created.
DevOps-bot: deploy-bot: heads-up: release window scheduled for 2024-08-11 02:00 UTC. If you have infra migrations that clash, comment on ENG-4720.
Elaine: Thanks — looks like concrete windows. If leadership needs to re-prioritize after customer signal, we'll update. If anyone has follow-ups, drop them here and we'll keep the thread updated. :party_parrot:
